ةﻮﻄﺨﺑ ةﻮﻄﺧ ..ﻚﺘﯾاﺮﻗ ﻲﻓPARAGRAPHS · UNIT 1 Golden Hills in the Sahara Festival
Douz Festival is one of the most prestigious festivals which recount the history and
folklore of Bedouin life. It takes place every year in DOUZ, a small city lying in the south
of Tunisia at a 30 km distance from the town of Kebili.
It starts on December 22nd and lasts for 4 days only, but its spectacularities turn it into
an unforgettable occasion.
Thanks to the spirit of joy and festivity it offers, the festival attracts thousands of
visitors annually, including natives, tourists and guests from all over the world. These
people are keen to attend the festival so as to follow with great pleasure such fabulous
activities as palm tree climbing, camel races and rabbit hunting competitions.
Chief among the ceremonial shows that characterize the festival of Douz are the
traditional marriage ceremonies.
For all these reasons and more, I think you should not miss the opportunity to come to
the festival.
Be sure that the enormous sense of appreciation and admiration that visitors have for
the festival every year goes beyond what words we can say.
